description: This is a Bash shell script for transcribing audio files using the OpenAI API. It parses command-line arguments, validates inputs, sets default values, and makes a cURL request to the API endpoint to perform the transcription, saving the output to a specified file.
external_files: potentially other scripts or environment files that set OPENAI_API_KEY and OPENAI_BASE_URL

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information and exits with error code 2 if invoked or if help requested.
